task: Wire npm_config_prefix/PATH env into spawn_external_ps (matching its sibling spawn functions) and improve the Windows install-wizard's failure message so it is actionable.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components across two layers: the Rust spawn_external_ps env fix (src-tauri/src/commands/pty.rs) plus a UI-layer failure-message improvement (ui/handlers.js or config/steps-windows.yaml wiring) — pattern for the env fix is copy-adapt from pty_env_pairs_for/shell_cmd_for, but the message change is a separate, less-precedented touch.

Core fix (env parity via npm_env_for) is well specified by technical-analysis.md, but the task-context naming mismatch (ticket names ui/setup-view.js; actual affected flow is the legacy install-Wizard in ui/handlers.js/config/steps-windows.yaml) and the exact wording/placement of the 'actionable' failure message are open decisions.

Exact pattern exists twice in-repo (pty_env_pairs_for, shell_cmd_for) to copy and adapt for spawn_external_ps, trivial rollback — kept just above XS because the existing Windows test for spawn_external_ps only checks exit code (no env assertion), so verification requires either a new Rust test or a real Windows run per acceptance criterion 5.
